Partition Scope

Partition scope using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

partition_scope(tasks, scope)

Example input

{
  "tasks": [
    {
      "name": "auth fix",
      "scope": "auth"
    },
    {
      "name": "new theme",
      "scope": "ui"
    }
  ],
  "scope": "auth"
}

Example output

{
  "active": [
    {
      "name": "auth fix",
      "scope": "auth"
    }
  ],
  "backlog": [
    {
      "name": "new theme",
      "scope": "ui"
    }
  ]
}

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py partition_scope < examples/partition-scope.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
